title: Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with chicken and a blend of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the curry to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the kicky and sour to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
